did: gate.py: added module-level `import builder` so the gate reads a seed's Goal with the builder's own reader.

gate.py: removed the v0.4 `_goal_text` and added `_goal_problems(rel, body)`, which runs `builder.note_text` then `builder.goal_section`; an unclosed `%%` comment yields `seed has a %% comment left open` and a missing/empty Goal yields `seed has no ## Goal with text`.
gate.py: `_seed_problems` now calls `problems.extend(_goal_problems(rel, body))` instead of `if not _goal_text(body)`, so the Goal check matches `builder.read_seed` and other checks still run.
unsure: Could not directly run `gate.py check` on the factory's own vault (no shell tool); relied on the green suite and on the seed's `%%` marks all sitting inside code spans, so note_text keeps them.

Did not verify whether importing builder emits the pydantic_graph DeprecationWarning on stderr when gate is run as a script, though the suite's builder import already triggers it and gate's contract is about stdout.
